gt_mask.rule: manipulated = (mask_L >= 128), i.e. mask/255 >= 0.5; masks are RGB with identical channels, converted to L
gt_mask.note: Decided by user after Phase A: masks have soft (anti-aliased) edges; only 47/678 strictly binary.

storage.scalars: image-level score, detection logit and all scalars written to results CSV at full float64 precision (repr)
storage.float16_check: Phase B smoke: <=6 px/image (<=8.6e-6) change at the 0.5 cut; |dIoU|,|dDice| <= 2.1e-4; kept float16 per user

prediction_rule: predicted manipulated = (anomaly map > prediction_threshold), strict, as in the official TruFor metrics.py (final Phase D decision; Phase B used >=, difference <= 1e-4 in pooled F1)
detection_rule: predicted manipulated = (image score > 0.5), official TruFor rule
